subtitle: From Padmanabha’s Servant to the ‘Model Native State’

panels.shot: low-angle wide of a royal figure before a temple sanctum, shadowed map of Travancore behind him
panels.action: Dharma Raja Karthika Thirunal Rama Varma stands in solemn profile before the Padmanabhaswamy shrine, palm on his sword hilt, as faint outlines of fort walls and rivers of Travancore glow behind him in the dusk.

dialogue.text: When Marthanda Varma died in 1758, many thought Travancore’s glory would fade. Instead, his nephew Dharma Raja turned a fragile conquest into a fortress state whose shadow would reach a century beyond him.

i18n.hi: १७५८ में मार्ताण्ड वर्मा की मौत के बाद सबको लगा त्रावणकोर की चमक ढल जाएगी, पर उनके भतीजे धर्मराजा ने नाज़ुक फतह को लोहे की किले-रियासत बना दिया, जिसकी छाया सौ साल तक टिकी रही।

panels.shot: somber interior medium shot, king beside a covered body, lamps flickering
panels.action: Inside a dim palace hall, Dharma Raja, still young, stands with folded hands beside the shrouded form of Marthanda Varma, oil lamps casting long wavering shadows on carved wooden pillars.

dialogue.text: On 7 July 1758, Marthanda Varma’s body lay still in Thiruvananthapuram. The man who had forged Travancore from warring chiefdoms was gone; the throne passed to his nephew, Karthika Thirunal Rama Varma.

i18n.hi: ७ जुलाई १७५८ को तिरुवनंतपुरम में मार्ताण्ड वर्मा का शरीर शांत पड़ा था; लड़ाकू नायकों को जोड़कर त्रावणकोर गढ़ने वाला चला गया, और गद्दी उनके भतीजे कर्तिका तिरुनाल राम वर्मा के हिस्से आई।

panels.shot: close-up on Rama Varma’s face as he looks up towards temple gopuram through a palace window
panels.action: Dharma Raja lifts his gaze through a latticed palace window toward the distant silhouette of the Padmanabhaswamy temple gopuram, his expression a mix of grief, resolve and uncertainty.

dialogue.text: Many had believed Travancore’s strength was only Marthanda Varma’s will. The question now was brutal and simple: had he built a state, or only a man’s legend?

i18n.hi: बहुतों को लगता था त्रावणकोर की ताकत बस मार्ताण्ड वर्मा की ज़िद थी; अब सवाल नंगा था – यह सच में राज्य था, या सिर्फ एक आदमी की दास्तान?

panels.shot: medium shot in temple courtyard, king with priests and officials around, hands folded
panels.action: In the sunlit courtyard of the Padmanabhaswamy temple, Dharma Raja stands barefoot among priests and ministers, hands folded, as the golden flagstaff rises behind him.

dialogue.text: Karthika Thirunal answered by bending his head. Like his uncle, he declared himself Padmanabha Dasa, servant of the deity, binding the crown again to the temple and the new bureaucracy around it.

i18n.hi: कर्तिका तिरुनाल ने सिर झुकाकर जवाब दिया; चाचा की तरह खुद को ‘पद्मनाभ दास’ घोषित किया, ताज को फिर मंदिर से, और उसके इर्द‑गिर्द बनी नई नौकरशाही से, कसकर बाँध दिया।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of a map-table with Rama Varma and officials leaning over it
panels.action: Around a low wooden map-table, Dharma Raja and senior officials study palm-leaf charts of Travancore’s boundaries, forts and neighboring states, their fingers tracing rivers and passes.

dialogue.text: He inherited more than land. There were standing troops, organized revenue offices, a courtly council, and a clear policy of guarding Cochin as a buffer between Travancore and rival powers to the north.

i18n.hi: उसे सिर्फ ज़मीन नहीं मिली; स्थायी फौजें थीं, सजा‑धजा महसूल दफ्तर, दरबारी परिषद और एक साफ नीति – कोचीन को ढाल बनाकर उत्तर के दुश्मनों से त्रावणकोर को बचाए रखना।

panels.shot: wide shot of lush landscape with an unfinished earthen rampart snaking through, workers tiny upon it
panels.action: Across a green Kerala landscape, an unfinished earthen wall winds between coconut groves and paddy fields, while groups of laborers with baskets and spades toil along its crest under overseers.

dialogue.text: But peace was an illusion. To the east, Mysore’s new rulers would soon push down the Ghats. Marthanda Varma had begun defensive works; under Dharma Raja, the Nedumkotta was to become Travancore’s backbone.

i18n.hi: पर यह सुकून धोखा था; पूरब में मैसूर के नए शासक जल्द ही घाटों से उतरने वाले थे; मार्ताण्ड वर्मा किलेबंदी शुरू कर चुके थे, धर्मराजा के हाथों नेडुमकोट्टा को ही त्रावणकोर की रीढ़ बनना था।

panels.shot: medium shot on rampart, king overlooking workers and soldiers training nearby
panels.action: Standing atop the rising earthen rampart, Dharma Raja watches lines of soldiers drill below as laborers tamp down the wall, palm trees and distant hills framing the scene.

dialogue.text: Stretching along the northern frontier, the Nedumkotta was more than a wall. It was a statement that Travancore was no longer a fragile principality, but a state that could plan, build and endure.

i18n.hi: उत्तर की सीमा पर पसरा नेडुमकोट्टा सिर्फ दीवार नहीं था; यह ऐलान था कि त्रावणकोर अब नाज़ुक रियासत नहीं, ऐसा राज्य है जो सोच सकता है, बना सकता है और टिककर लड़ सकता है।

panels.shot: stormy wide shot of frontier, wall in foreground, dark clouds over the Ghats
panels.action: Dark monsoon clouds pile over the Western Ghats beyond the sturdy earthen rampart, while Dharma Raja, cloaked against the rain, stares toward the unseen interior where Mysore gathers strength.

dialogue.text: By the 1770s and 1780s, Mysore under Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan pressed into Malabar. Travancore’s wall and alliances would be tested as never before, and the kingdom’s survival hung on its new institutions.

i18n.hi: १७७०–८० के दशक में हैदर अली और टीपू सुल्तान का मैसूर मलबार तक धँस आया; त्रावणकोर की दीवार और उसकी स्यासी दोस्तियाँ पहले कभी न देखी गई अग्नि‑परीक्षा से गुज़रने वाली थीं।

panels.shot: tense medium shot in council hall, king listening while a messenger gestures urgently
panels.action: In the royal council hall, Dharma Raja sits upright as a dust-covered messenger, hands outstretched, urgently describes advancing Mysore forces, while ministers lean forward anxiously.

dialogue.text: Reports came of Mysore’s campaigns in Malabar, its harsh exactions and shifting alliances. Travancore’s rulers sought British support, strengthened their lines and braced for a blow at the Nedumkotta.

i18n.hi: मलबार में मैसूर की चढ़ाइयों, भारी वसूली और बदलती यारियों की खबरें आती रहीं; त्रावणकोर के शासकों ने अंग्रेजी सहारा टटोला, मोर्चे मज़बूत किए और नेडुमकोट्टा पर पड़ने वाले वार के लिए खुद को कड़ा किया।

panels.shot: dawn wide shot along Nedumkotta, silhouetted soldiers at the parapet facing distant foes
panels.action: At first light along the Nedumkotta, silhouettes of Travancore soldiers stand alert on the parapet, spears and matchlocks ready, with distant campfires glowing beyond the wall.

dialogue.text: In 1789, Tipu Sultan’s advance reached Travancore’s defenses. The Nedumkotta delayed and bloodied the push, drawing British power fully into the conflict and weaving Travancore tighter into imperial politics.

i18n.hi: १७८९ में टीपू सुल्तान की चढ़ाई त्रावणकोर की हदों से भिड़ी; नेडुमकोट्टा ने बढ़त को रोक कर लहूलुहान किया, और अंग्रेजी ताकत को पूरी तरह इस जंग में खींच लाया, जिससे त्रावणकोर और गहरे साम्राज्य की सियासत में बुना गया।

panels.shot: interior medium shot, king at a desk lit by lamp, palm-leaf documents spread out
panels.action: Late at night, Dharma Raja sits at a low desk, a single oil lamp illuminating bundles of palm-leaf records, maps and letters as he signs and seals an official order.

dialogue.text: Even as he managed war and diplomacy, Karthika Thirunal kept the machinery of state moving; revenue offices, judicial arrangements and military commands formed layers of rule that no single man alone could carry.

i18n.hi: जंग और सुलह दोनों संभालते हुए भी कर्तिका तिरुनाल ने राज्य की मशीनरी चलती रखी; महसूल दफ्तर, अदालतों की नई रूपरेखा और फौजी कमानें ऐसे परत‑दर‑परत तंत्र बनाते गए जिन्हें कोई अकेला आदमी ढो नहीं सकता था।

panels.shot: time-lapse style wide, same cityscape evolving across frames from 18th to 19th century
panels.action: A composite cityscape of Thiruvananthapuram shifts subtly from tiled-roof houses and temple spires to include new tiled school buildings, a domed observatory and a large official court structure.

dialogue.text: In the nineteenth century, under his successors, those layers thickened. New schools, law courts, a medical establishment, engineering works, printing presses and an observatory grew out of the old Travancore frame.

i18n.hi: उन्नीसवीं सदी में उत्तराधिकारियों ने इन परतों को और मोटा किया; पुराने त्रावणकोर के ढाँचे से नए स्कूल, अदालतें, अस्पताल, इंजीनियरिंग काम, छापाखाने और वेधशाला उग आईं।

panels.shot: medium shot of an observatory courtyard with instruments against the sky
panels.action: Within a walled compound, brass astronomical instruments—quadrants, sundials and a small dome—stand aligned under the open sky, with a few scholars in simple robes studying them.

dialogue.text: The Travancore State Manual later recorded observatories, manuscript libraries and technical institutions. British officials, observing these, would speak of a ‘Model Native State’ in a landscape of princely polities.

i18n.hi: त्रावणकोर स्टेट मैनुअल बाद में वेधशालाओं, पांडुलिपि पुस्तकालयों और तकनीकी संस्थाओं का ज़िक्र करता है; इन्हें देखकर अंग्रेज अफसर इस रियासत को राजघरानों की दुनिया में ‘मॉडल नेटिव स्टेट’ कहने लगे।

panels.shot: interior wide of a courtroom with judge on dais and people of different backgrounds seated
panels.action: Inside a high-roofed courtroom, a robed judge sits on a raised seat while men in varied dress—Nair officials, Syrian Christian clerks, and others—sit or stand in ordered rows below.

dialogue.text: By the late nineteenth century, law courts and administrative councils had spread. Yet, as scholars like Robin Jeffrey note, the dominance of certain elites and the deep scars of caste still shaped who truly held power.

i18n.hi: उन्नीसवीं सदी के आखिर तक अदालतें और प्रशासनिक काउंसिलें दूर‑दूर फैल चुकी थीं; पर जैसा विद्वान रॉबिन जेफ़री बताते हैं, कुछ ऊँचे तबकों की पकड़ और जाति के गहरे ज़ख्म अब भी असली सत्ता तय करते रहे।

panels.shot: somber street-level shot showing people of different castes segregated in a town lane
panels.action: On a narrow town lane, upper-caste figures walk confidently in the center while lower-caste men and women keep to the edges, some bare-torsoed, heads bowed as a high-caste party passes.

dialogue.text: Marthanda Varma’s reforms and Dharma Raja’s rule did not end Kerala’s severe caste hierarchy. Untouchability, segregation and ritual exclusions endured, shaping everyday life long after their reigns.

i18n.hi: मार्ताण्ड वर्मा की सुधारों और धर्मराजा के राज ने केरल की सख्त जाति‑सीढ़ी नहीं तोड़ी; अस्पृश्यता, अलग‑थलग बस्तियाँ और अनुष्ठानिक पाबंदियाँ उनकी मौत के बहुत बाद तक रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी को बाँटती रहीं।

panels.shot: wide shot of a mission school with children of various communities outside
panels.action: In front of a simple mission school building, children from different communities gather with slates and palm-leaf books while a missionary teacher speaks to a local assistant under the shade of a tree.

dialogue.text: Christian missions, new schools and printing presses opened doors for some communities. Historians like Dick Kooiman trace how education and conversion debates intersected with rising demands for social equality.

i18n.hi: मसीही मिशन, नए स्कूल और छापाखाने ने कुछ बिरादरियों के लिए नए रास्ते खोले; इतिहासकार डिक कूइमान दिखाते हैं कि पढ़ाई और धर्म‑परिवर्तन की बहसें बराबरी की बढ़ती माँगों से कैसे टकराईं।

panels.shot: medium shot of a calm Sree Narayana Guru-like figure before a simple shrine, followers around
panels.action: A calm ascetic figure stands before a modest shrine, hand raised in blessing, as men and women from marginalized castes gather around him in quiet attention.

dialogue.text: In the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, reformers such as Sree Narayana Guru challenged the old order, founding temples and organizing communities long confined to the margins of Travancore’s sacred geography.

i18n.hi: उन्नीसवीं सदी के आख़िर और बीसवीं की शुरुआत में श्री नारायण गुरु जैसे सुधारकों ने पुरानी व्यवस्था को ललकारा, नए मंदिर रचाए और उन समुदायों को संगठित किया जिन्हें त्रावणकोर की पवित्र ज़मीन पर सदियों से हाशिए पर धकेला गया था।

panels.shot: crowd scene wide at a temple entrance in 1936, gates open, diverse people stepping in
panels.action: Before a grand Kerala temple gateway in 1936, its doors flung open, men and women from previously excluded castes step hesitantly inside as officials and onlookers watch.

dialogue.text: The 1936 Temple Entry Proclamation, issued in Travancore, allowed many formerly excluded communities to enter public temples, addressing injustices that had stood, largely untouched, since the time of Marthanda Varma and Dharma Raja.

i18n.hi: १९३६ की मंदिर प्रवेश घोषणा ने, जो त्रावणकोर से निकली, पहले से बाहर रखी गई कई जातियों के लिए सार्वजनिक मंदिरों के दरवाज़े खोले, उन नाइंसाफ़ियों को छूते हुए जो मार्ताण्ड वर्मा और धर्मराजा के ज़माने से लगभग बेअसर पड़ी थीं।

panels.shot: slow push-in on an older Dharma Raja in profile, half in shadow, scrolls and a sword beside him
panels.action: An older Dharma Raja sits in profile in a quiet chamber, one hand resting on a bundled scroll, the other near a sheathed sword, his face lined, half lit and half in shadow.

dialogue.text: Between Marthanda Varma’s conquests and the later ‘Model State’ lay men like Dharma Raja, who kept the machinery of Travancore turning; his legacy was not a perfect kingdom, but a state sturdy enough for later generations to challenge and change.

i18n.hi: मार्ताण्ड वर्मा की फतहों और बाद के ‘मॉडल स्टेट’ के बीच धर्मराजा जैसे लोग खड़े थे, जिन्होंने त्रावणकोर की मशीन लगातार चलाए रखी; उनकी विरासत कोई बेदाग़ जन्नत नहीं, पर इतना मजबूत राज्य थी कि अगली पीढ़ियाँ उसे चुनौती देकर बदल सकें।

title_i18n.en: Dharma Raja and the Model State Inheritance

subtitle_i18n.en: From Padmanabha’s Servant to the ‘Model Native State’
subtitle_i18n.hi: पद्मनाभ दास से बना ‘मॉडल नेटिव स्टेट’
